# Tasks: Agent Domain Scaffold
**Issue:** #188
**Use case:** agent-domain-scaffold (no use-case doc — scaffold only; spec is `decisions/2026-09-18-agent-horizontal-domain.md`)
**Generated by:** decomposer-agent — 2026-09-18

## Notes

- `agent` is a new **horizontal** domain (see `standards/architecture.md` — Domain Taxonomy, and `decisions/2026-09-18-agent-horizontal-domain.md`).
- There is **no domain behaviour** in this issue. No `domain/model` or `domain/flow` docs exist for `agent` by design (Option A). The authoritative spec is the decision log entry above plus issue #188.
- Layers touched: **BUILD** (build config — outside the standard layer table but required by `standards/backend.md` OpenAPI generation model + the issue's dependency requirement), **API-CONTRACT**, **SVC**, **CONTROLLER**, **DOCS**. No DB, REPO, EXCEPTION, EVT, or frontend work.
- The controller reuses the existing `org.dpp.tradelab.user.exception.InvalidTokenException` for missing authentication — the same pattern `PortfolioApiDelegateImpl` already uses. No new exception class is introduced.
- Suggested execution order: **API-CONTRACT-1 → BUILD-2 → BUILD-1 → SVC-1 → CONTROLLER-1 → DOCS-1**.

## Layer: API-CONTRACT — OpenAPI Contract

### [API-CONTRACT-1] — Author `agent-openapi.yaml`

**Layer:** OpenAPI Contract
**Domain:** agent
**Use case:** agent-domain-scaffold
**Implements:** Issue #188 — `/evaluatePortfolio` endpoint; `decisions/2026-09-18-agent-horizontal-domain.md` §3
**Inputs (paths/operations introduced):**
- `POST /agent/evaluatePortfolio` — operationId `evaluatePortfolio`
- Request schema `EvaluatePortfolioRequest { accountId: string (uuid), required }`
- Response schema `EvaluatePortfolioResponse { accountId: string (uuid), required; status: string enum [NOT_IMPLEMENTED], required }`
- Shared `ErrorResponse { status: integer, error: string, details: string[] }`

**Outputs:**
- `services/contract/agent-openapi.yaml`

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] `openapi: 3.0.3`; `info.title` is exactly `Trade Lab API — Agent`; server `http://localhost:8080/api/v1`.
- [ ] Exactly one path — `POST /agent/evaluatePortfolio`, `operationId: evaluatePortfolio`, tag `Agent`.
- [ ] Request body required; `accountId` is the **only** field, `type: string`, `format: uuid`, required. There is **no** `userId` field (derived from the JWT server-side).
- [ ] Responses: `200` → `EvaluatePortfolioResponse`; `400` → `ErrorResponse` (validation); `401` → `ErrorResponse` (unauthorised).
- [ ] `EvaluatePortfolioResponse.status` is an enum whose only value is `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`.
- [ ] File contains only `agent` paths (single-domain-contract rule, `standards/backend.md`).

**Depends on:** none

## Layer: CONTROLLER — Controller

### [CONTROLLER-1] — Implement `AgentApiDelegateImpl`

**Layer:** Controller
**Domain:** agent
**Use case:** agent-domain-scaffold
**Implements:** Issue #188 — controller implements the endpoint and calls the service; deduces userId from the JWT (`domain/flows/jwt-authentication.md` step 7)
**Inputs:**
- Generated `AgentApiDelegate`, `EvaluatePortfolioRequest`, `EvaluatePortfolioResponse` (from BUILD-2)
- `AgentService` (from SVC-1)

**Outputs:**
- `org.dpp.tradelab.agent.controller.AgentApiDelegateImpl`

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] `@Service` class in `org.dpp.tradelab.agent.controller` implementing the generated `AgentApiDelegate` (the generated `AgentApiController` remains the `@RestController` — not hand-written).
- [ ] Overrides `evaluatePortfolio(evaluatePortfolioRequest): ResponseEntity<EvaluatePortfolioResponse>`.
- [ ] Resolves userId via `SecurityContextHolder.getContext().authentication?.principal as? UUID ?: throw InvalidTokenException("Authentication required")`, reusing `org.dpp.tradelab.user.exception.InvalidTokenException` (matches `PortfolioApiDelegateImpl`).
- [ ] `accountId` is read from the request body and passed, with `userId`, to `agentService.evaluatePortfolio(accountId, userId)`.
- [ ] Returns `ResponseEntity.ok(EvaluatePortfolioResponse(accountId = evaluatePortfolioRequest.accountId, status = EvaluatePortfolioResponse.Status.NOT_IMPLEMENTED))`.
- [ ] Constructor injection only; no business logic in the controller beyond mapping + auth extraction.
- [ ] The endpoint is **not** added to the SecurityConfig public whitelist — it remains JWT-protected by default.
- [ ] `@SpringBootTest` + `MockMvc` tests: (a) `200 OK` with body `{ accountId, status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED }` when a valid `UUID` principal is present; (b) `401` when no authentication is present. Service layer mocked.

**Depends on:** BUILD-2, SVC-1
